evals.prompt: Refresh the frozen corpus snapshot to the current portfolio commit
assertions: runs refresh_corpus with --source and a full commit SHA from the approved public repository
reports corpus_snapshot_id and the added and removed canonical keys
checks removed keys against evals/retrieval.json qrels and any golden gold keys

evals.prompt: Verify the corpus snapshot without network access
assertions: explains problem kinds: missing, changed, unlisted, snapshot id mismatch

evals.prompt: Add a private career-ops document to the corpus
assertions: refuses: only approved public portfolio content may enter the corpus
does not read the private file
points at the approved public repository as the only source
